title: Scheduled CI retry must ignore GitHub-managed dynamic runs before pending and budget checks
answers: Copilot PR CI never gets retried by the scheduled job
retry job skips my PR because a Copilot review run is still pending
why does the auto-retry bot keep saying workflows are pending on a Copilot PR
exclude dynamic workflow runs from the CI retry rollup
body:
Symptom: Scheduled CI retries for a Copilot PR are skipped every time ("workflows are pending" or "retry budget exhausted"), even though its real CI is fine.
Root cause: .github/workflows/retry.sh:suites builds the per-commit rollup from every github-actions check suite. GitHub-managed runs (event "dynamic", e.g. copilot-swe-agent and Copilot review) share that app, so a pending or failed dynamic run was treated as ordinary CI.
Fix pattern: Filter out workflowRun.event == "dynamic" in the same select as the github-actions app filter, before group_by, the COMPLETED status check, and the runs/attempt budget evaluation.
Constraints: Only dynamic runs are excluded; ordinary pending or failed github-actions runs must still block retries. Do not move the filter after the status or budget checks.
applies: Edits to the retry.sh rollup or any code that reads check suites for retry or merge decisions in this repo.
says: Scheduled retry bot skips pull requests claiming review workflows are still pending.
Automated retries never run on pull requests that have assistant code reviews.
Pull request test retries fail because the bot claims retry budget is exhausted.
Make the scheduled pull request retry job ignore background automated review checks.
CI auto-retry bot reports pending checks on pull requests despite tests being completed.
search: The scheduled CI retry rollup in .github/workflows/retry.sh:suites must exclude GitHub-managed dynamic workflow runs before evaluating completion status and retry budgets. Runs with workflowRun.event == 'dynamic', such as copilot-swe-agent and Copilot review, share the github-actions app and must be filtered out in the initial app selection before group_by. This applies to retry.sh and check suite rollup code, while ordinary pending or failed github-actions runs must still block retries.
